title: DeST-OT: Alignment of Spatiotemporal Transcriptomics Data
tldr_zh: 用 semi-relaxed FGW 对齐时空转录组切片，建模生长/凋亡/分化并给出 growth-distortion 与 migration 度量。
tldr_en: Aligns spatiotemporal transcriptomics slices via semi-relaxed FGW, modeling growth/apoptosis/differentiation with growth-distortion and migration metrics.
